description: The University of Virginia Biocomplexity group deposits a coarse SPW synthetic population for Sweden. Zenodo presents a public ZIP, README, contact matrix and graphics with CC BY 4.0 rights metadata. The README documents person and household CSVs, residential and activity sites, and a table connecting each person to daily activities. It lists GPW population counts, World Bank activity templates and OpenStreetMap-derived points of interest. These files can provide agents and tentative destinations for Swedish service-access or emergency-response simulations once network and facility data are supplied. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this Sweden release. A limitation is that the README does not state which household-size source generated its household table. The activity links are synthetic, not measured commuting or crisis response, and do not establish local network loads. The archive was not downloaded; row counts, geocoding precision and validation graphics were not checked.
